title: BetterEssentials
description: All-in-one SMP utility plugin with maintenance, combat logging, and gameplay controls.
body:
DISCLAIMER: THIS IS NOT A RECREATION/BETTER VERSION OF THE PLUGIN "EssentialsX". 
This is still in heavy development, if you change the MOTD you might need to change it in the config file too.

Icon by cr4wn

**For server owners. Engineered for simplicity.**

tested for the most part, if bugs do occure report them in the discord server linked.

⚠ DISCLAIMER: This plugin uses bStats to show anonynomus information about players, servers and more. To disable: toggle the "metrics-enabled" inside config.yml. ⚠

# Core Features
### BE Offers a load of essential stuff, like:
- Dimension control - Kicks people when toggled
- Advanced combat/danger logging (Beta)
- Item restrictions (Netherite banning, Specific item banning + more)
- Power options
### Server settings:
- Grace period
- No hunger loss
- No PvP
- No Phantoms

## + Much More...



### Commands:

  /Betteressentials:
    Main command
    permission: betteressentials.admin
    aliases:
      - be
      
  /bebroadcast:
    Broadcast a title and chat message
    permission: betteressentials.admin
    aliases:
      - bebc
      - bbroadcast
      - bbc
      - bebroadcast
      - betteressentialsbroadcast

### permissions:
  betteressentials.admin:
    Allows access to all BetterEssentials commands
    default: op
    
  betteressentials.maintenance
    Allows bypassing the maintenance
    default: op
